meta.title: Download the BondCheck Android app
meta.description: Check prize bonds, track your own bonds and get draw day reminders with the free BondCheck app for Android. No account needed.

hero.title: BondCheck for Android
hero.subtitle: Check prize bond results in seconds, save your bonds without an account, scan bond numbers with the camera and get reminded on draw day. Works in English and Urdu.

cta.direct: Direct download from this website. The file is not served from any other site.

checksum.title: Verify the file
checksum.body: After downloading, you can compare the file's SHA-256 checksum with this value.
checksum.missing: No checksum was published for this file.

steps.title: How to install
steps.one: Tap Download for Android. Your browser saves the APK file.
steps.two: Open the downloaded file from the notification or your Downloads folder.
steps.three: If Android asks, allow installing apps from your browser. This is needed for apps that are not from the Play Store.
steps.four: Tap Install, then Open. Future updates are offered inside the app.

qr.title: On a computer?
qr.body: Scan this code with your phone's camera to open this page on your phone.

safety.title: Is it safe?
safety.body: The app is built by an automated release process and signed with the BondCheck release key. It uses the camera, or a photo you pick, only when you choose to scan bonds, and notifications only when you turn on reminders. It never reads your location or contacts.

iphone.title: Using an iPhone?
iphone.body: There is no iPhone app yet. The BondCheck website works on every phone and can be added to your home screen.
